第241章 陆听雪之惊天隐秘两人结为道侣心圣宗轰动（第1页）
“什么意思，你有两种先天道体？”
“对，我除了明面上的一种先天道体，其实还有第二种先天道体。只是，这第二种先天道体太特殊了，特殊到我不敢公之于众，只敢一直隐藏。可惜，百密一疏，还是被云天明给察觉了，这才是云天明一直逼迫我成为他的道侣的真正原因！”
正因为如此，他才接受了突如其来的死亡，将所有敌人都算计了，凯撒终究是凯撒，他连自己的死亡，都设计成了打击政敌的犀利武器。
龙木皆成乌黑色，数千上万根堆积在一起，才形成这样一座巨巢，无尽的龙气汹涌，当一阵罡风吹过，露出内部的景象。
何天龙让手下干警为和尚做了记录，好说歹说，终于把他们打发走，靠在椅子上揉捏着隐隐作痛的太阳穴，脸上满是痛苦之色。
我回到酒店之后躺在床上，黄家在这里很有权势，又是道门世家，不好惹，我心里还是有些犹豫究竟要不要去管这件事。我现在已经洗清了嫌疑，完全可以让肖楠自己去查。
花朵儿守在门前，从猫眼向外面看了看，见并没有任何人注意到这边的情况，才眼神示意甜宝可以开始了。
律昊天仍旧的冷漠的对待着白忆雪。他翻过身，身上还是不大舒服。白忆雪见状，知道律昊天是躺的太久不大舒服，顿时起身，去将床摇了起来。让律昊天靠坐在那里。
好半响，我才从激动和兴奋中冷静下来，我也不知道为什么忽然之间就会做一个很奇怪的梦，忽然之间得到了养鬼道的道统传承。
“多谢蚩尤前辈！”将七十二个练窍之法牢记在心后，夏阳诚心地向他道了一声谢。
无数冲天的烟花，似乎标志着大乾王朝的真正盛世已经到了巅峰。
姜彦明连声答应了，长揖别了姚镇江，扶李丹若上了车，直奔直顺街过去。
现在，林川属于以彼之道还施彼身，让他们重走当年的路，从而铸就江海大学的辉煌。
要是是陈秋的话，话都不用手，只要陈秋有个想要的眼神，她就立马答应，跟下车了，而这猥琐青年长的质量实在太差了。
林凡离开了大约一个时辰，一团黑雾从黑海冲出的那处地下缓缓的升起。
洪峻峰此时算是见识到了林川的厉害，这人不声不响的，直接咽住了他们。
就这样，这一行人互相的，都用这种‘呛话’的方式交流了一遍，也算是互相都打了个招呼吧。

这时候大长老也是沉声道，江茗听此也是嘴角一翘，这老家伙都什么时候了，居然还想着这些有的没的东西？
方莫从来没有这么迷茫过，自从他学了道术一来，还从未遇到过这么怪异的事情，就好像，他以前的所学，全部变成了废纸一般。
“怎么，我都不行吗？”程子鹏有点不爽了，之前他还在周凡面前保证了。
虽然警察和家消防武警还没有来，但四周还有一些保安在维持秩序，看到周凡如此冲动的想要跑到院子里，顿时大惊，连忙呼喊道。
现在，连陈国栋都低头，酒店贱卖了，深怕得罪林川，谭明义却还执迷不悟？
给他的感觉就像是，在冷宫里面的妃子看着一个太监给她端来一份毒酒和一丈红让她选择的场景。
顾绫雪没有立即做实验，而是准备先跟众人解释一下电的概念，来帮助他们更好的理解电的流动和能量转换。

The latest chapter of Full Level Martial Saint: Starting from the Peerless Magic Skills_Chapter 241 Lu Tingxue’s shocking secret and the two of them becoming Taoist lovers. Sensational Page 1 of the Heart Saint Sect_Full Level Martial Saint: Starting from the Peerless Magic Skills in Moon Zhongyin_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 241 Lu Tingxue’s shocking secret: the two became Taoist couples and the Heart Saint Sect caused a sensation (page 1)
Chapter 241 Lu Tingxue’s shocking secret: the two became Taoist couples and the Heart Saint Sect caused a sensation (page 1)
"What do you mean, you have two innate Tao bodies?"
"Yes, in addition to the one innate Tao body that I have on the surface, I actually have a second type of innate Tao body. However, this second innate Tao body is too special, so special that I dare not make it public, so I dare to hide it all the time. Unfortunately, despite all the secrets, Yun Tianming still noticed it. This is the real reason why Yun Tianming has been forcing me to become his Taoist companion!"
Because of this, he accepted the sudden death and plotted all his enemies. Caesar is Caesar after all. He even designed his own death as a sharp weapon to attack his political opponents.
The dragon trees are all black, and thousands of them are piled together to form such a giant nest. Endless dragon energy surges, and when a strong wind blows, the scene inside is revealed.
He Tianlong asked his police officers to take notes for the monks, and after some persuasion, he finally sent them away. He leaned on the chair and rubbed his aching temples, with a look of pain on his face.
After I returned to the hotel, I lay on the bed. The Huang family was very powerful here and it was a Taoist family, so it was not easy to mess with. I was still a little hesitant in my heart whether to take care of this matter or not. Now that I have cleared the suspicion, I can let Xiao Nan investigate on his own.
Hua'er stood guard in front of the door and looked out through the peephole. When she saw that no one was paying attention to the situation here, she signaled to Tianbao that it was time to start.
Lu Haotian still treated Bai Yixue indifferently. He turned over, still feeling uncomfortable. When Bai Yixue saw this, she knew that Lu Haotian was not feeling comfortable after lying there for too long, so she immediately stood up and went to shake the bed. Let Lu Haotian sit there.
It took me a long time to calm down from the excitement and excitement. I don't know why I suddenly had a very strange dream, and suddenly got the inheritance of ghost raising.
"Thank you, Senior Chi You!" Xia Yang thanked him sincerely after keeping the seventy-two techniques of practicing in his mind.
Countless fireworks soaring into the sky seemed to mark that the true prosperity of the Daqian Dynasty had reached its peak.
Jiang Yanming agreed repeatedly, bowed his head and said goodbye to Yao Zhenjiang, helped Li Danruo get into the car, and walked straight down the street.
Now, Lin Chuan is the one who wants to repay the other person's way, allowing them to go back to the path of the past, thus creating the glory of Jianghai University.
If it were Chen Qiu, she wouldn't even use her words. As long as Chen Qiu had a look of desire, she would immediately agree and get off the bus. However, the quality of this wretched young man was really poor.
Lin Fan left for about an hour, and a black mist slowly rose from the ground where the Black Sea broke out.
Hong Junfeng had finally seen how powerful Lin Chuan was. The man swallowed them without making a sound.
In this way, this group of people communicated with each other in this "choking" way, which can be regarded as saying hello to each other.
At this time, the great elder also said in a deep voice. Jiang Ming also raised the corner of his mouth when he heard this. How long has this old guy been thinking about these things?
Fang Mo had never been so confused. Ever since he learned Taoism, he had never encountered such a weird thing. It was as if everything he had learned before had turned into waste paper.
"Why, can't I do it?" Cheng Zipeng was a little unhappy. He had promised it in front of Zhou Fan before.
Although the police and fire fighters hadn't arrived yet, there were still some security guards around to maintain order. Seeing Zhou Fan impulsively wanting to run into the yard, he was shocked and shouted quickly.
Now, Lian ChenGuodong bowed his head, the hotel was sold at a low price, and he was deeply afraid of offending Lin Chuan, but Tan Mingyi was still stubborn?
It felt to him like a concubine in the cold palace watching a eunuch bring her a poisonous wine and a foot of red for her to choose.
Gu Lingxue did not conduct experiments immediately, but planned to explain the concept of electricity to everyone to help them better understand the flow of electricity and energy conversion.
